title: Multiple ergodic averages — Problem 34
exact_target: Does every positive-measure set recur under two multiplicative transformations whose indices form the legs of a Pythagorean triple?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 4800034 (AMR-047-0034). CC BY 4.0.
N. Frantzikinakis, Some open problems on multiple ergodic averages (2016), Section 8, multiplicative-system definition and full Problem 34, p.36.
